'''First Recon''' was a unit in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Devlin (Nautolan)|Devlin]] that was deployed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They were ordered by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to set up a beachhead in the [[deep caverns]] of [[the Tomb]] and begin data collection, but they were overrun by [[Esh-kha]] and many were captured.
